_generic: It happened, and then it was over.
History will not record this. The History tab will.
He felt this was a good use of a minute.
Somewhere, a dragon did the same thing, but bigger.
museum: The museum did not visit back.
He understood at least one painting.
art_gallery: He nodded at a painting. It did not nod back.
One picture was clearly about him. It was not.
cafe: He drank it slowly, like a person with nowhere to be.
The foam looked like a duck. He thought.
bakery: He was not the only one who loved the croissant. He was the only one who said so.
park: A pigeon judged him and moved on.
garden: A bee was busier than him. Fair.
He smelled a flower. The flower did nothing.
library: He was quiet. So was everyone. It worked.
A book looked at him. He looked away first.
bar: The bartender had heard that one before.
He ordered with confidence. The confidence left early.
restaurant: The waiter called him 'sir'. He felt tall.
He left one pea. On purpose.
fast_food: The tray was the best part.
shop: The shop had things. He looked at them.
A shopkeeper smiled. He smiled harder.
place_of_worship: It was very quiet. Even his shoes agreed.
He lit a candle for his feet.
monument: It stood there. So did he. A draw.
The monument has been here longer. It showed.
castle: No dragons today. He checked twice.
The walls were thick. So was the guidebook.
fountain: He made a wish. The fountain kept the coin.
Water went up. Then down. Riveting.
railway: The trains were on time. He was not going anywhere.
He waved at a train. Nobody waved back.
zoo: A goat stared at him for a full minute.
